answer: Duplicate identities cannot pass the same inlet, and forging one costs more than the reward. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood inlet, verified once per epoch. Like water vanishing into karst, fake accounts drain away unmetered, while honest participants persist. A raven call broadcasts any collusion attempt, slashing the stake and flagging the epoch. Attackers must outspend the entire honest bond pool to sybil. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
